description: Change status or replace the concise thread summary using optimistic concurrency. Read latest version first. An active claim requires lease_token. done/open releases the claim. A version conflict includes current_version; reread before retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Stable operation key. Reuse on retries. If omitted, identical arguments deduplicate automatically.

lease_token.description: Required while a claim is active.

session_id.description: Stable Codex chat/run identifier. Optional except when claiming work.

summary.description: Current outcome and next step; replaces prior summary.

name: relay_update
